    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    pl.initdate AS start_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(perfsol.perfmoment, pl.initdate))::int AS service_years,
    p.paneeffpct AS efficiency_values,
    (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric AS ann_degrade_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(
        ((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric - p.paneeffpct) / 
        NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(perfsol.perfmoment, pl.initdate)), 0) * 100 
    AS numeric), 4) AS pelr,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric - p.paneeffpct) / 
        NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(perfsol.perfmoment, pl.initdate)), 0) * 100) / 
        NULLIF((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric, 0)
    AS numeric), 4) AS ndi,
    CASE 
        WHEN (((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric - p.paneeffpct) / 
             NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(perfsol.perfmoment, pl.initdate)), 0) * 100) / 
             NULLIF((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric, 0) > 1.5

    pl.initdate AS installation_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, pl.initdate))::int AS years_in_service,

    (perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric AS annual_degradation_rate_pct,
    ROUND(CAST(

    ROUND(CAST(
        ((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct')::numeric /

        NULLIF((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric, 0)
    AS numeric), 4) AS normalized_degradation_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((perfsol.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct')::numeric /
